pages.text: $(t2)Tier 2$() bosses live in Twilight Forest, Blue Skies, and The Aether. First Simply Swords uniques drop here. Prepare full steel or manasteel.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest:$() Naga (Tempest), Lich (Soulrender), Hydra (Emberblade), Ur-Ghast (Whisperwind 20%), Knight Phantom (Enigma), Snow Queen (Frostfall), Alpha Yeti (Icewhisper).$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies:$() Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, Arachnarch - each drops a unique.$(br2)$(bold)Aether:$() Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit - each drops a unique.
